name: page-header
summary: Introduces a page with one H1 and optional supporting description.

agent.useWhen: A page needs its primary H1 and optional supporting context. Compose app-owned actions and sibling navigation outside this component.
agent.avoidWhen: A nested card, dialog, or section needs a local heading, or the heading requires actions inside its own markup.

invariants: The title is always rendered as the page's H1; a nonblank description is optional supporting text.
Title and description are plain text, HTML-escaped, nonblank when supplied, and contain no control characters.
Only title and description are component inputs. Actions and arbitrary markup are not exposed; the app composes actions and sibling navigation outside the component.
The static header owns no IDs, events, commands, routes, client state, or JavaScript lifecycle.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[page-header]] slot; the renderer expands it as a single-pass substitution.
